name: Sofia Smyth
source:
The history teacher, and wife of the Dean, at Vesper University. Sofia has a strained relationship with her husband, who is wholly focused on his work. Because of this, Sofia hasn't been able to have the big family she's always dreamed of, more than anything else.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
